license.name: Partition Plus, Inc.
license.registry: Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) business name search, Maryland Department of Labor; Pennsylvania OAG Home Improvement Contractor registration (hicsearch.attorneygeneral.gov)
license.note: No license was found because no lookup was possible. Neither state requires a state license or registration for commercial partition installation, and the repo shows no Harrisburg city rule. Maryland's MHIC licence covers residential home improvement only (research/state-licensing/states.json, citing labor.maryland.gov/LICENSE/oplinks.shtml). Maryland says a Circuit Court clerk construction licence 'may be necessary' for commercial contracts; that is county level and not searchable online. The Harrisburg area is in Pennsylvania, where the Attorney General's Home Improvement Contractor registration also covers residential work only (over $5,000 a year). The repo has no Harrisburg city rule (local_note null in research/installers/extra-areas.json). The MHIC search page is behind Google reCAPTCHA (the search button stays disabled until it is solved), so the business could not be checked there. The PA search at hicsearch.attorneygeneral.gov did not respond to automated access. Repo prospect notes say the company sells and installs commercial partitions (partitionplus.com/about-us/). Its MHIC status is unknown.
